description: The workspace's plan now, what set it (`stripe` for a subscription, `manual` for our team, null when neither a subscription nor our team set it: the free plan nobody bought), the subscription's status as Stripe says it, and when the paid month ends. `changeVia` says how the plan changes: `checkout` (choose a plan), `portal` (a subscription is live, so the plan or card changes in the billing portal) or `support` (our team set it; write to hello@colding.app). `available` is false while payments aren't open. `limits` are the numbers the workspace is held to now (the plan's with any the team set by hand laid over; null means no limit, 0 means not included) and `usage` is what it has used of each, counted as that limit's own check counts it: seats include pending invitations, `dailySends` is today on the workspace's clock, `addressChecksPerMonth` is this UTC month, and `transactionalDailySends` is the most one mailbox sent today. Above a limit the workspace keeps what it has and can't add more. `planKnown` is false when the stored plan isn't one this version knows; `plan` and `limits` then read Free's. An API key can't choose a plan or pay: ask the owner with create_handoff (kind manage_billing), then read the plan here.
name: get_billing
title: Get the plan and billing
